name: Files
short_desc: View: Your own cloud folder for videos, documents and folders, shared by every Wizard app.
author: File Browser (filebrowser.org); packaged by Humanity Labs
description: Unmodified File Browser on Runtipi's shared media folder: upload, download, share and organise videos, documents and folders from any browser, including iPhone Safari (large uploads are sent in resumable chunks). Other apps use the same folder: put a video in Videos, ask Hermes to edit it with DeFleur Video, and the result lands in Videos/Edited. No login by default: keep Runtipi private (e.g. Tailscale). Set a password before exposing it on a public domain.

form_fields.label: Password (optional; turns the login on)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty for no login, only if Runtipi is reachable just on your private network (e.g. Tailscale). With a password, sign in as user admin. Always set one before exposing Files on a public domain.
